text:
Maria: heads-up — AcmeCo (AC-912) onboarding stalled. Kickoff done, but 0 API calls in 7 days. they hit infra/terraform errors and paused. need quick save plan + downgrade-safe path.
AJ: thanks — what did support see in the logs? any error codes?
Maria: support found repeated 403 from our proxy gateway and a terraform apply that failed on a network resource. I'll paste the snippet.
Maria: ```
Error: creating subnet: resource_already_exists
status: 409
```
Devon: ok, typical infra hiccup. propose micro-save play: short pairing, token swap to sandbox, and targeted docs.
Devon: micro-save checklist: 1) 30m pairing with infra + dev, 2) issue temp sandbox token, 3) run quick smoke tests (3 endpoints), 4) follow-up enablement within 48h.
Samir: +1. Add a downgrade guard: if they ask to reduce to free tier, we offer a 30-day "pause + enablement" instead of immediate downgrade. keeps data & momentum.
AJ: timeline? who owns outreach?
Maria: I can own outreach today. booking window: 30–60m tomorrow. Devon will join pairing. Samir handles the downgrade guard script.
onboard-bot: Reminder: onboarding playbook template updated — https://console.redwood.dev/onboarding-playbooks/no-engagement
Devon: Suggested message for outreach: "Hi <name>, noticed no calls yet — can we do a 30m pairing to unblock infra? We’ll provide a sandbox token and run smoke tests together." short + actionable.
Maria: sending now. tagging follow-ups: @Devon (pairing), @Samir (billing guard), @AJ (escalation if no response in 48h).
AJ: track in the weekly retention board and add a one-line recap to AC-912 in Gainsight.
Samir: billing guard note: prepare a reversible downgrade flow: keep snapshots, preserve workspace keys, set a 30-day reactivation credit. script: `hold_billing(acct,30d,preserve_keys=true)`
Maria: update — customer replied, prefer Wed 11am. I booked pairing and sent sandbox token. will post results here after session. :thumbsup:
Devon: great. if pairing reveals config issues we can push a small infra snippet to their repo and run apply with them. usually fixes within 45m.
Maria: post-pairing plan: 1) confirm 3 successful calls, 2) enroll into enablement play (15m tips), 3) 30-day low-touch check-ins.
AJ: nice concise play. saving this thread as a micro-save template for similar 'no-engagement' cases.
Maria: agreed — will copy into /playbooks/micro-saves and link from onboarding docs. closing thread when enablement done."
